description: The full timeline of one run: every model turn with its token counts and stop reason, every tool call with its arguments and result, every shell command with its exit code, and every file the run changed. This is what tells you why an agent did something, rather than what it cost.

run.description: Run id, or "last" for the newest recording. Defaults to "last". Replay traces are skipped when resolving "last", so it means the newest run you actually recorded.

name: orca_show_run
